name: glb_generic
description: Binary glTF: the exporter converts to +Y up (its fixed conversion is the same as -Z forward, Y up), images embedded in the file, deform bones only, no leaf bones, no animation, no shape keys, rest pose. Bone names unchanged. No vertex colours: the look is the baked atlas, and the build's flat palette colours would otherwise go out as a second colour stream beside a forced white one; a target that wants them declares its own profile.
